newsitem.title: UK: Portugal tenders to buy up to 150,000 tonnes fuel.
newsitem.headline: Portugal tenders to buy up to 150,000 tonnes fuel.

text.p: Portugal's state power company Electridade de Portugal (EdP) has tendered to buy up to six cargoes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery at the end of September and in October, traders said.

The tender, according to an EdP offical, calls for four cargoes of 25,000 tonnes plus two optionals with delivery of one cargo in September and the remainder in October. All cargoes are to be delivered into Lisbon.
But some traders were unsure of the tender details, claiming the requirement was for only five cargoes.
